title: Discovery matches the library, opens what we lack, and has TV
summary: Discovery asks the servers by guid=tmdb://, which real servers ignore, so every title reads as missing; the mock answers it, so smoke passes. Add a page for titles we lack, and TV rows.

rows.text: /library/all?guid=tmdb://1396 and guid=imdb://tt0903747 return 0 for Breaking Bad, which the server holds.
/hubs/search?query=…&includeGuids=1 returns the item with Guid [imdb, tmdb, tvdb] and its year, for films and shows. Search returns albums and episodes too, so filter by type and year.
askServers -> copiesByGuid(tmdb://) swallows the empty answer as 'Not in your library'.
The mock answers guid=tmdb://, so smoke passes on the broken lookup.

brief.direction: Replace the tmdb:// guid lookup with a title search verified by the hit's TMDB id; then add TV rows on the same path, and let an unheld title open the detail page with no copy and a TMDB trailer through the recap player.

rejected.option: Look up by imdb:// guid via TMDB external_ids
rejected.why: measured: guid=imdb:// also returns 0 on Maverick

rejected.option: Match on title and year alone
rejected.why: same-titled films collide; the TMDB id in the hit's Guid is exact

rejected.option: A separate screen for unheld titles
rejected.why: detail.ts already draws TMDB facts; a no-copy mode is smaller than a second page
